# holding cost basis

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:holdingCostBasis`](gmeow-holdingCostBasis.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/holdingCostBasis>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/finance`](../../slices/finance.md)

The cost basis of the holding — the original monetary amount paid to acquire the asset. Functional: a holding has one canonical cost basis (disputed values are standpoint-indexed claims).
